propositions: Compromised GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN was logged in plaintext in uvicorn access logs because the review-bot sourced the token from the URL query parameter ?token= instead of a header

Fix 66af (commit 4e8c83c833, Gerrit change 1384) moves token sourcing from URL query string to X-Rebar-Token header and adds TokenRedactingFilter, but was not yet deployed to the production container when this ticket was created

The token must be rotated via service-user.sh to update the bot's Gerrit HTTP password, SSM parameter /rebar/prod/gerrit-bot-token, and webhooks.config simultaneously, rather than via bare aws ssm put-parameter which would desync the shared secret
Rotation must occur after deploying 66af to production and restarting the review-bot container, otherwise the new rotated token would be immediately re-logged in plaintext
Post-rotation verification requires confirming inbound webhook triggers (via /rerun) and outbound LLM-Review votes succeed with the new credential
